install.hint: Official methods vary by platform (Homebrew on macOS; Snap, pacman, dnf or a release archive on Linux; a release archive on Windows); follow the docs page for yours. Only Homebrew on macOS is automated here; Linux and Windows use the docs page. Not verified against a real machine: see project/documentation/digitalocean-connect-research.md.

auth.instructions: Create a DigitalOcean API token in your DigitalOcean control panel yourself, then run `doctl auth init` in a terminal and enter the token at its own prompt (add `--context <name>` to keep several accounts apart). doctl keeps the token in its own credential store: do not paste it into this chat, and do not put it in a project file. Tell me when you are done. Afterwards, approve the digitalocean-droplets MCP server in Claude Code and complete its own DigitalOcean sign-in (OAuth); that is a separate consent from the doctl token. DigitalOcean's hosted MCP server has one endpoint per service and only the Droplets one is registered here; add others from the MCP docs page by hand (re-running this does not remove them).
